description: Export from the active PCB to a file and return its path: gerber (zip for fabrication), pnp (pick and place csv), bom, netlist, step, obj (3D), dxf, dsn (for external routers), ipc356, ipc2581, odb, testpoints, info, altium, pads, view (picture of what the canvas shows). Nothing is ordered: EasyEDA's ordering functions are never called.

options.description: Passed to h.pcb.exportFile: {name?, type?, unit?, layers?, objects?, ...}.

path.description: Absolute file path or directory. Default: ~/.easyeda-mcp/out/

name: pcb_export
